claims.statement: CoupledForm is the same-instance relation in which a same-lineage retained body/action route is currently used, the same trace-use occurrence mediates present fit, and that mediation was jointly formed in the declared history.
claims.domain: One admitted actual P/H0/I0/K binding with body/action coordinate, event and consumer fixed.
all_premises: independent K grounding and sorted witnesses
claims.proof: Definition with explicit conjunctive typing; no existence assertion follows from the definition.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Stored or copied values, high performance, empirical R-F covariance and reports do not satisfy the relation without all conjuncts.

claims.statement: The marginal view (R,F,output,report) does not identify CoupledForm: the native and yoked worlds agree at (1,1,1,1) and differ only in the required mediation/formation relation.
all_premises: R and F retain the declared meanings
claims.proof: Direct enumeration and the displayed two-world counterexample; four marginal keys admit both coupling values.
claims.counterexamples_limits: This is not a universal biological impossibility or a claim that no richer view identifies the relation.

claims.statement: Failure to install an independent R by F factorial does not entail that every mixed organizational bridge is undefined; a higher-order coupling relation may differ while R and F necessarily covary.
claims.domain: A4L's terminated pure-candidate comparison and the A4M witness class.
all_premises: A4L termination is installation-specific rather than universal
CoupledForm is not defined as the marginal conjunction
claims.proof: The native/yoked pair has fixed R=F=1 and distinct C, so C is not eliminated by absence of independent marginal variation.
claims.counterexamples_limits: A proposed coupling relation still needs physical grounding and may fail to exist in a particular bearer.

claims.statement: If every CoupledForm primitive is independently grounded in one complete actual signature and all R157/effective-R173 same-instance premises hold, C1 transports that relation to an experience-internal structural counterpart.
claims.proof: Inherited formula preservation under the C1 isomorphism; every conjunction and quantified witness is transported in the same signature.
claims.counterexamples_limits: It does not transport external archives or labels and does not supply familiar-mineness semantics or measurement.

claims.statement: B_cf interprets the transported CoupledForm relation as positively relevant to the selected character that present fit unfolds through an already established body/action manner.
claims.domain: Predeclared selected target H_cf; partial/graded values permitted; no universal necessity claim.
claims.proof: No proof of truth is claimed; the contract states explanatory content and three independent refuter forms.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Sufficiency-fiber contrast, native/yoked target invariance, or matched external-tool target under a body-specific claim can refute the declared bridge.

claims.statement: Coupled formation is not an additive decomposition, exclusive owner, basal-experience condition, report, self-model, generic fluency or complete explanation of ownership/agency/familiarity.
claims.domain: UCT interpretation of A4M-C1 through A4M-C5.
claims.proof: Concept, scope, quantifier and inference-direction audit.
claims.counterexamples_limits: Later applications may add named interoceptive/affective relations but must not silently revise this bridge after outcomes.
